final_template:
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.0"
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 5.0"
    }
  }
}

variable "rolename" {
  description = "Name of the IAM role"
  type        = string
  default     = "WizAccess-Role"
}

variable "remote_arn" {
  description = "Cross-account principal ARN allowed to assume the role"
  type        = string
  default     = "arn:aws:iam::830522659852:role/prod-us43-AssumeRoleDelegator"
}

variable "external_id" {
  description = "External ID required for STS assume role"
  type        = string
  default     = "fc959d31-537c-4108-8b87-9af9e0c9b8d2"
}

resource "aws_iam_role" "wiz_access_role" {
  name = var.rolename

  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Effect = "Allow"
        Action = "sts:AssumeRole"
        Principal = {
          AWS = var.remote_arn
        }
        Condition = {
          StringEquals = {
            "sts:ExternalId" = var.external_id
          }
        }
      }
    ]
  })
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "view_only_access" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.wiz_access_role.name
  policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/job-function/ViewOnlyAccess"
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "security_audit" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.wiz_access_role.name
  policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/SecurityAudit"
}

  name  = "terraform-bot-group-membership"
  users = [aws_iam_user.terraform_bot.name]
  group = aws_iam_group.terraform_bot_group.name
}

resource "aws_iam_policy" "terraform_policy" {
  name        = "terraform-policy"
  path        = "/"
  description = "Permissions for Terraform-controlled EKS cluster creation and management"
  policy      = data.aws_iam_policy_document.terraform_policy.json
}

resource "aws_iam_group_policy" "mfa_enforcement" {
  name  = "mfa-enforcement"
  group = aws_iam_group.terraform_bot_group.name

  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Effect   = "Allow"
        Action   = "*"
        Resource = "*"
        Condition = {
          Bool = {
            "aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent" = "true"
          }
        }
      }
    ]
  })
}

resource "aws_iam_group_policy_attachment" "terraform_bot_custom" {
  group      = aws_iam_group.terraform_bot_group.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.terraform_policy.arn
}

  group      = aws_iam_group.terraform_bot_group.name
  policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemFullAccess"
}

final_template:
terraform {
  required_version = "~> 1.0"

  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 5.0"
    }
  }
}

variable "username" {
  type    = string
  default = "my_vpn_infra_user"
}

variable "group_name" {
  type    = string
  default = "my-vpn-infra-group"
}

variable "membership_name" {
  type    = string
  default = "my-vpn-infra-manager-group"
}

variable "project_tag" {
  type    = string
  default = "my-vpn-tag"
}

variable "policy_path" {
  type    = string
  default = "/my_vpn_infra/"
}

resource "aws_iam_user" "main" {
  name          = var.username
  force_destroy = true
  tags = {
    ProjectTag = var.project_tag
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_group" "main" {
  name = var.group_name
}

resource "aws_iam_group_membership" "main" {
  name  = var.membership_name
  group = aws_iam_group.main.name
  users = [aws_iam_user.main.name]
}

resource "aws_iam_access_key" "main" {
  user = aws_iam_user.main.name
}

resource "aws_iam_group_policy" "mfa_enforcement" {
  name  = "mfa_enforcement"
  group = aws_iam_group.main.name

  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Sid    = "DenyAllExceptListedIfNoMFA"
        Effect = "Deny"
        NotAction = [
          "iam:CreateVirtualMFADevice",
          "iam:EnableMFADevice",
          "iam:GetUser",
          "iam:ListMFADevices",
          "iam:ListVirtualMFADevices",
          "iam:ResyncMFADevice",
          "sts:GetSessionToken"
        ]
        Resource = "*"
        Condition = {
          Bool = {
            "aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent" = "false"
          }
        }
      },
      {
        Sid    = "AllowWhenMFAPresent"
        Effect = "Allow"
        Action = "*"
        Resource = "*"
        Condition = {
          Bool = {
            "aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent" = "true"
          }
        }
      }
    ]
  })
}

resource "aws_iam_policy" "basic_policy" {
  name        = "basic_policy"
  path        = var.policy_path
  description = "Basic STS identity policy"
  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Effect   = "Allow"
        Action   = "sts:GetCallerIdentity"
        Resource = "*"
      }
    ]
  })
  tags = {
    ProjectTag = var.project_tag
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_policy" "create_policy" {
  name        = "create_policy"
  path        = var.policy_path
  description = "EC2 resource creation policy"
  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Effect = "Allow"
        Action = [
          "ec2:CreateKeyPair",
          "ec2:CreateVpc",
          "ec2:CreateSubnet",
          "ec2:CreateInternetGateway",
          "ec2:CreateRoute",
          "ec2:CreateRouteTable",
          "ec2:CreateLocalGatewayRouteTableVpcAssociation",
          "ec2:CreateSecurityGroup",
          "ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress",
          "ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress",
          "ec2:CreateReplaceRootVolumeTask",
          "ec2:CreateTags",
          "ec2:AllocateAddress"
        ]
        Resource = "*"
      }
    ]
  })
  tags = {
    ProjectTag = var.project_tag
  }
}
